description: Kick off an automated QA run (headless-browser checks) against a hosted app. Poll vibekit_qa_status for results.
name: vibekit_run_qa

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: QA run start confirmation with run id/status.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Run QA
